title: Entries of the encoded zone word
statement: Let $w$ be a finite list of optional Boolean values, and let $b$ be a Boolean choosing an encoding order. Each list entry is encoded by two Boolean entries: when $b$ is true, they are its presence indicator followed by its value, and when $b$ is false, they are its value followed by its presence indicator. An absent value is encoded using false for its value. For every position $p$, the encoded word has an entry there exactly when $w$ has an entry at position $\lfloor p/2\rfloor$; the encoded entry is the first of that pair when $p$ is even and the second when $p$ is odd.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $w$ of optional Boolean values
